folds.heading: ## Current authority and adoption reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B59)
folds.body: Read the full round chronology: Round7 and PRIMARY_ADOPTION advance selected Q1/Q2/Q3/Q6/Q7/Q8 beyond Round6’s branch-only/blocked stage. Their lint/census/ledger fields still do not prove semantic quality or every saved idea’s fulfillment. Current build.js contains the BUILD_OUT bundle/HTML path and live-asset-link preview route; this is source presence, not a new concurrent-build/browser receipt or immutable package. Current AGENTS/CLAUDE carry generated global agreement pointers, so Q14’s repeated full-text-copy description is historical; this review measured no current client-load/token saving. AD43’s floor is accepted, PRF/FND remains proposed. Accepted AD51 supersedes IPC60/FND5 if read as requiring two implemented worlds before designing a shared seam: design from known sources, then a second world validates/revises it; local laws remain local. AD52 separately governs compressed activity choices/costs/knowledge/clocks. IPC85’s suggested report commit cannot supply authorization; this reconciliation remains local/uncommitted. Old Q waiting/worker/model fields and proposed rulebook order are history, not a new dispatch, adoption vote or prerequisite to current lead work.
